WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS baseline
  FROM signals
), above_first AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate, fb.baseline AS first_baseline
  FROM telescope_averages AS ta
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS fb
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > fb.baseline
), second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM above_first
), final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT af.avg_pulse_rate, af.first_baseline, sb.baseline AS second_baseline
  FROM above_first AS af
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS sb
  WHERE af.avg_pulse_rate > sb.baseline
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate - first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline,
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate - second_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline
FROM final_telescopes;
